subject: Countersigned SOW - Q3 revenue analytics engagement
body:
Hi Younes,

Great to have this over the line. Attached is the fully countersigned statement of work for the Q3 revenue analytics engagement. The agreed fee is EUR 24,000, invoiced in full on signature, payable net 30.

Please send the invoice to accounts payable and cc me. Looking forward to kicking off.

Best,
Petra Lang, Head of Procurement, Nordwind Logistics GmbH

subject: Signed - subscription billing redesign
body:
Younes,

Signed copy attached. Total engagement is EUR 45,000, split across three equal milestones: EUR 15,000 at kickoff, EUR 15,000 at the midpoint review, and EUR 15,000 on final delivery. Please invoice the kickoff milestone now so we can get started this week.

Saludos,
Marc, COO, Barcelona Retail Group S.L.

subject: Advisory retainer - countersigned
body:
Hi Younes,

Delighted to confirm. The advisory retainer is USD 6,000 per month for an initial six-month term, billed monthly in advance. Signed agreement attached. First invoice can go out for this month.

Warm regards,
Layla Haddad, Managing Partner, Falcon Advisory FZ-LLC

subject: Order form signed
body:
Hi Younes,

Signed order form attached. All the commercial figures and the payment schedule are in the order form itself, please raise the invoice against those. Currency is GBP as discussed.

Thanks,
David Okoro, Finance Director, Meridian Health Ltd

expected.flag_reason: amount is in the attached order form, not in the email body

subject: Deal is on - let's get invoiced
body:
Younes,

We're good to go. Total is 50k as agreed, net 15. Contract attached and signed. Send the invoice whenever you're ready.

Omar, Gulf Data Systems

expected.flag_reason: currency not stated, do not infer from the .ae domain

subject: Signed agreement - please bill in USD
body:
Hi Younes,

Signed agreement attached. The fee in the contract is quoted as EUR 30,000, but for our internal accounting please issue the invoice in USD at today's rate. Net 30.

Kind regards,
Sabine Frei, Helvetia Instruments AG

subject: Contract signed - implementation support
body:
Hi Younes,

Signed and attached. The fee is EUR 10,000 plus VAT, payable net 14. Our VAT ID is on the contract if you need it for the invoice.

Beste Gruesse,
Thomas Berg, Rheinbach Software GmbH

subject: Signed contract - please issue compliant e-invoice
body:
Hi Younes,

Contract signed, attached. Fee is AED 80,000, net 30. Please issue a tax-compliant e-invoice including 5% VAT. Our TRN is 100234567800003, it must appear on the invoice.

Regards,
Nadia Suleiman, Finance Manager, Sands Hospitality LLC

subject: Firmado - intra-EU B2B
body:
Hola Younes,

Signed contract attached. Fee is EUR 18,000, net 30. This is an intra-EU B2B supply, so please apply the reverse charge, our VAT number is ESB12345678. No Spanish VAT to be charged.

Un saludo,
Pau Serra, Iberia Mobility S.A.

subject: we're in!
body:
Hey Younes,

So excited to finally do this. Signed the thing, it's attached. On money, let's do twelve thousand total, and I'd like to pay half when we actually start (that's September for us) and then the other half once you wrap everything up, which will probably land around November. USD. Let me know if that works and just send whatever you need.

Jenna

subject: Proposal looks good - sending to legal
body:
Hi Younes,

The proposal at EUR 20,000 looks good to us. I'm passing it to legal for signature this week and will send the countersigned version once it's done. Nothing to action on your side yet, just wanted to confirm we're moving ahead.

Ravi, Cobalt Ventures

expected.flag_reason: unsigned proposal, awaiting signature, do not invoice

body: Your business, simplified. Sign an annual contract before the end of the month and save $120 on QuickBooks Online. Automate invoicing, track expenses, and get paid faster. Terms apply. Manage your subscription or unsubscribe below.

subject: Quick question on invoice #1042
body:
Hi Younes,

Quick one, on invoice #1042 you sent last month, could you confirm whether the EUR 24,000 was net or gross of VAT? Our AP team flagged it. No rush, just need it for their records.

Thanks,
Petra

expected.flag_reason: support question about an existing invoice, not a new contract

subject: Re: Verde deal - where are we
body:
Younes,

Caught up with Verde. They're basically agreeing to the 40k, split 50/50. I think we can close it this week. Let's not send anything until they've actually signed though, last time we jumped the gun. Talk later.

Sami

subject: Signed - scope to be confirmed
body:

Signed agreement attached. As discussed, the fee will land somewhere between EUR 8,000 and EUR 12,000 depending on how the final scope shakes out over the next two weeks. Happy for you to get the paperwork ready in the meantime.

Grace, Atlas Freight Co

body:
